visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable/source-terrain frames, including the 1024x640 summary. Individual Porto Cathedral has granite fortress twin towers, pale faceted domes and corner pinnacles, a west rose with eight visible spokes beneath an archivolt, layered portal/pilasters, a long crenellated nave, buttressed transepts, red-tile choir/crossing roofs, northeast chapel and low north baroque loggia. Immediate mapped cloister/Casa do Cabido ranges surround an open Gothic courtyard. Corrected hidden rose spokes, unsupported cornices, buttress-overlapped clerestory openings, missing distant chapel roof and excessive small finial heights. Exact sculpture, tracery and narrative tile scenes are simplified.
